No red ground after January 96. But the recoveries were logged in March 1995, ten months before the change, and already they said white direct. A head coming home from thieves should have come home wearing its own 1977 number, red over brick dust. Why paint a new one at all?

And why did the returns have red under their numbers?

Either someone painted them old style for fun. Or the returns had been numbered in 1977, and the display heads had never carried a number until somebody needed them to.
